purpose: Record the post-S43 backlog gate without inventing a new implementation slice or synthetic domain-governance evidence.

candidate_gate_review.reason: S35 can capture evidence only when a real Work Slice uses S28/S29 against a qualifying agent, prompt-injection, untrusted-content, web/API, auth, tenant, secret or trust-boundary concern.
S18 still requires at least five reviewed Work Observatory records in one stable comparison group before comparative metrics are admissible.
ADR-016 still requires repeated evidence that existing contracts cannot carry required runtime meaning before an explicit boundary decision.
S43 resolved the selected two-roadmap reference repair and did not create authority for a repository-wide scanner, generator or follow-up implementation.

decision.next_admissible_trigger: A source-backed Work Slice involving S28/S29-relevant agent or trust-boundary risk, a new explicit evidence gate for S18 or Runtime 2.0, or a concrete reader-facing defect discovered in current repository sources.
decision.rationale: The backlog can advance by recording the gate, but should not create artificial implementation work after S43. This keeps the roadmap honest and protects future evidence quality.
